notes.title: Update #1 Major Update !
notes.content:
All levels are available !
All levels were made available after a few adjustments in the first 24 hours of early access.

Bug between level 2 & 3 FIX
Cursor sometimes miss click FIX
(because the game showed him bigger than he really was)
Bug on Final Boss FIX

Now every time you kill a Boss or Elite,  widgets appear on the left side, to indicate
to the player he has won a Skillpoint or a Ruby.

The firs AIs of "Never Rain" have been nerf and the first Boss a little bit too.

On the seller's widget
the keys to press for the dash capabilities and the spirit shield
have been added

Many changes are still coming to leave your feedbacks

Damage font changes a lot more pretty and pleasant.

Coming soon a Endless Horde Mode ...
(Few Days not week)
